name: bridgr
description: Ask your company's own Bridgr about its data: where it stands, what it still needs, what it noticed, and questions answered from its read-only access. Connects to your company's Bridgr only; you sign in and approve in your browser, never a password here.

bridgr_url.title: Your company's Bridgr address
bridgr_url.description: From your Bridgr welcome or Connect data email, just https:// and the host, with no /mcp and no trailing slash. Example: https://yourcompany.eastridge-analytics.com. Bridgr only lets you in if you are on that company's list.
